why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance, with when, what it was for, and the amount. Refunds carry a "Refund" badge and a "Refund: …" label. Charges are red and credits green. It has loading, empty and error states, and the text is in both en.json and ko.json with matching keys. `tsc --noEmit` is clean and eslint reports no new problems in the file. I haven't opened the page in a browser.

+    def refund_credits(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Gives back the credits charged for `action_type` because the AI work failed,
+        and records a positive transaction.
+        """
+        session.rollback()  # the session may be in a failed state after the error
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+        if not workspace:
+            return
+        tier = workspace.tier if workspace.tier else "free"
+        cost = self.PRICING.get(action_type, {}).get(tier, 5)
+
+        workspace.credits += cost
+        session.add(workspace)
+        session.add(CreditTransaction(
+            workspace_id=workspace_id,
+            user_id=user_id,
+            amount=cost,
+            action_type=f"refund_{action_type}",
+            timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+        ))
+        session.commit()
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def refund_on_failure(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str):
+        """
+        Wrap the AI work that follows `deduct_credits`: any exception raised inside
+        refunds the charge and is re-raised.
+        """
+        try:
+            yield
+        except BaseException:
+            self.refund_credits(session, workspace_id, user_id, action_type)
+            raise
+

+        """Refund from a background task, which has no request session."""

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def ws_id(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    r = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws_id(client, h)}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items[:2]] == [
+        (15, "refund_generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+    ]
+    assert all("created_at" in i for i in items)
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+
+def test_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}", headers=h)  # triggers the daily refill
+    items = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h).json()
+    assert {"amount": 50, "action": "daily_refill"}.items() <= items[0].items()
+
+
+def test_history_is_404_for_non_members(client):
+    owner = signup(client, "a@example.com")
+    other = signup(client, "b@example.com")
+    wid = ws_id(client, owner)
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history").status_code == 401
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{missing}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404

+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters", headers=h, json={"project_id": project_id, "name": "Mina"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 485
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_via_workflow_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(
+        f"{API}/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "x", "style": "webtoon"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_text_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    calls = [
+        ("/projects/styles/recommend", {"description": "soft watercolor"}),
+        ("/characters/augment", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina", "tags": [], "mood": "calm"}),
+        ("/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+        ("/scenes/structure", {"script": "A bus at night", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/scenes/render", {"prompt": "a bus", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": "http://x/y.png", "instruction": "darker", "project_id": pid}),
+    ]
+    for path, body in calls:
+        before = credits(client, h)
+        r = client.post(f"{API}{path}", headers=h, json=body)
+        assert r.status_code >= 400, (path, r.status_code, r.text)
+        assert credits(client, h) == before, path
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "ink wash"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
